editorial: Today, automation and file parsing technologies stand out in software development processes. In particular, Microsoft's document processing tool and Anthropic's coding assistant set new standards that increase productivity in developer tooling.

items.title: microsoft/markitdown
items.summary: Developed by Microsoft, MarkItDown is a Python tool that converts various file formats and office documents into markdown language (Markdown) format. This tool makes it easy to bring unstructured data into processable text format for large language models.

items.title: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
items.summary: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an automation tool that creates high-resolution short videos with a single click using large language models. This Python-based software speeds up the content creation workflow by automating the process of generating video content from text input.

items.title: anthropics/claude-code
items.summary: Claude Code is an agent-based coding tool that runs on the terminal and analyzes the code base with natural language commands. It is designed as an assistant that performs routine tasks in software development processes, provides code comments and manages version control (git workflows).

items.title: cursor/plugins
items.summary: Cursor has released the official plugin specification, allowing developers to create their own plugins within the code editor. This TypeScript-based structure allows developers to integrate customized workflows directly into the editor environment.

items.title: revfactory/harness
items.summary: Harness is a meta-talent framework that designs AI agent teams specific to specific domains and creates the specialized skills these teams need. The system automates specialized agent definitions and workflows to perform complex tasks.

items.title: EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin
items.summary: The Compound Engineering plugin integrates compound engineering processes for development tools such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. It enables management and automation of complex tasks in software development workflows.

items.title: affaan-m/ECC
items.summary: ECC offers a system that optimizes skills, memory and security layers for artificial intelligence coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor. It provides a research-oriented infrastructure to increase agent performance in software development processes.

items.title: OpenBMB/VoxCPM
items.summary: VoxCPM offers a tokenizer-free text-to-speech (TTS) model for multilingual speech production, creative sound design, and realistic voice cloning. This approach enables more natural and flexible sound synthesis processes by working directly on sound data, unlike traditional methods.

items.title: galilai-group/stable-worldmodel
items.summary: Stable-worldmodel is a platform developed to ensure the reproducibility of research on world models. The software provides a standard framework for simulating and evaluating environmental interactions of AI models.

items.title: Crosstalk-Solutions/project-nomad
items.summary: Project N.O.M.A.D brings together tools, information resources and artificial intelligence components designed for an offline survival computer that does not require an internet connection. This system aims to ensure that critical data and digital capabilities are accessible under all circumstances.

items.title: run-llama/liteparse
items.summary: Developed with the Rust language, Liteparse is an open source tool designed to parse documents quickly and efficiently. This solution functions as a high-performance document parser, making it easier to extract data from complex document structures.

items.title: chen08209/FlClash
items.summary: FlClash stands out as a multiplatform proxy client based on ClashMeta. This open source application, developed with Dart language, offers an ad-free and user-friendly interface experience.

items.title: FareedKhan-dev/train-llm-from-scratch
items.summary: This work shared by FareedKhan-dev explains step by step the process of training large language models from scratch, from downloading datasets to text production. The content in Jupyter Notebook format embodies the model development processes accompanied by a technical guide.

items.title: ruvnet/RuView
items.summary: RuView uses standard wireless network (WiFi) signals to perform real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign tracking and presence detection without the need for image data. This software, developed in Rust language, offers a contactless monitoring solution using the existing network infrastructure.

items.title: DataTalksClub/data-engineering-zoomcamp
items.summary: Data Engineering Zoomcamp is a free nine-week training program that covers the processes of creating production-ready data pipelines. Offering participants the opportunity to learn end-to-end data engineering practices, this course follows a practice-oriented curriculum through Jupyter Notebooks.

items.title: OpenMOSS/MOSS-TTS
items.summary: MOSS-TTS is an open-source model family designed to perform high-fidelity and expressive speech synthesis. It supports complex scenarios such as long-term conversations, multi-speaker dialogues, character design, and real-time streaming text-to-speech.

items.title: dreammis/social-auto-upload
items.summary: Developed with Python, social-auto-upload is a tool that allows automatic upload of videos to social media platforms such as Douyin, Xiaohongshu, TikTok, YouTube and Bilibili. Offering multi-platform support, this software automates content distribution processes and eliminates the need for manual uploading.

items.title: anthropics/skills
items.summary: Anthropics open source its library of reusable agent skills that enable artificial intelligence agents to perform complex tasks. This Python-based structure allows developers to standardize agent-based workflows.

items.title: codecrafters-io/build-your-own-x
items.summary: The Build-your-own-x project aims to improve programming skills by providing guides for building popular software technologies from scratch. Developers learn the working logic of complex systems such as databases or operating systems through applied projects.

items.title: The dead economy theory
items.summary: Dead economy theory argues that the majority of interactions and content on digital platforms are created by bots rather than humans. This approach points to a synthetic network environment where internet traffic and economic data do not reflect real user behavior.

items.title: SQLite is all you need for durable workflows
items.summary: Developers prefer to use SQLite database instead of complex infrastructures to create durable workflows. This method simplifies state management processes and increases the reliability of the system.

items.title: Notes from the Mistral AI Now Summit
items.summary: The new models introduced at the Mistral AI Now summit offer optimized performance, especially for small language models running on end devices. The company aims to increase efficiency and local processing capacity in corporate applications with open-weighted models.

items.title: Danish pension fund excludes SpaceX citing governance and valuation
items.summary: A Denmark-based pension fund has removed SpaceX shares from its investment portfolio, citing concerns about corporate governance standards and company valuation. This decision reflects the difficulties private space companies have in meeting investors' expectations for transparency and governance.

items.title: It's hard to justify buying a Framework 12
items.summary: The Framework 12 model is criticized by users for its high price and limited performance efficiency, despite the hardware upgradeability advantage it offers. The modular nature of the device makes it difficult to make a cost-based justification compared to other laptops on the market.

items.title: openbmb/MiniCPM5-1B
items.summary: MiniCPM5-1B, developed by OpenBMB, stands out as a text-generation model with a low number of parameters. Aiming to offer high performance in limited computing resources, the model adopts an architecture suitable for working on edge devices.

items.title: nvidia/LocateAnything-3B
items.summary: Developed by Nvidia, LocateAnything-3B stands out as an image-text-to-text model that performs object positioning tasks by processing visual and textual inputs. This model optimizes the processes of locating objects in visual data and transforming this data into text-based outputs.

items.title: HauhauCS/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive
items.summary: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive, published on HuggingFace, is a multimodal language model that can process visual and text input. The model, which draws attention with its uncensored structure, offers a customized performance in image-to-text conversion processes.

items.title: meituan-longcat/LongCat-Video-Avatar-1.5
items.summary: Developed by Meituan, LongCat-Video-Avatar-1.5 is a generative AI model that enables the creation of high-quality video avatars from text input. The system is designed to produce consistent visual output in character-oriented video synthesis processes.

items.title: bytedance-research/Lance
items.summary: Developed by ByteDance, Lance is a multi-modal (any-to-any) model that can simultaneously process different types of data such as text, images and audio. This architecture offers flexible interaction in cross-modal tasks by providing direct conversion between different modalities.
